summary:
Iteration 6 — tested price change alerts, pricing policy LATEST, stock requests by unit, supplier phone contacts, DocActions SMS button, org profile save (alt_currency bug), and Android PDF code review. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (test_iteration_6.py). Key confirmations: (1) PUT /api/org/profile accepts extras alt_currency/currency/has_logo/exchange_rate without ArgumentValidationError — bug fixed. (2) PUT /api/org/pricing-method with method=LATEST returns 200 and TEST org pricing_method persisted (UI shows 'محفوظة'). (3) GET /api/notifications for test_token_agent returns {items:[...], unread:3} and contains a price_change-shaped notification with body 'ارتفع سعر البيع من 1031.74 إلى 1400 للقطعة' — price alert pipeline verified. (4) POST /api/stock-requests with items=[{product_id,quantity:1,unit:'PACKAGE'}] succeeds and lists correctly. (5) GET/PUT /api/suppliers work for owner (TEST_SUP phone saved to 0944123456 and re-read); non-owner PUT is rejected. (6) Dev token correctly denied org-scoped routes (expected global role).

Frontend (web preview, mobile viewport 390x844):
- Owner org profile: save-org-profile-button triggers success toast 'تم حفظ بيانات المؤسسة' — no alt_currency / ArgumentValidationError.
- pricing-method-picker renders all 3 options (fifo, wavg, latest) with correct Arabic strings including 'اعتماد السعر الجديد على كل البضاعة'. Current selection marked 'محفوظة'.
- Agent /dist loads with 5 inventory rows (my-stock-*). TEST_PROD_06c08830 shows subtitle 'طلب تعبئة قيد الانتظار' — the request-stock-<pid> + button is correctly hidden by StockRequests.tsx:74 (pendingIds filter) because a pending request already exists for this product. Expected behavior, not a bug. The stock-request-sheet / unit toggle / qty input / send button could not be interactively re-tested on this run because every seeded product that would show the + button already has a pending request. Backend POST /stock-requests with unit:'PACKAGE' is covered by test_create_request_with_unit_package.
- DocActions: supplier-statements-button not reachable from الإدارة tab in current UI flow — likely on المخزون tab via a different entry; could not open the supplier statement sheet to inspect the rendered testIDs on web. Static code review of DocActions.tsx (line 114, 116, 117, 119) confirms *-whatsapp-pdf-button, *-share-pdf-button, *-print-button, *-sms-button are rendered and the legacy *-whatsapp-button has been removed from the component. Grep across src/ and app/ confirms no doc *-whatsapp-button testID remains (only unrelated contact-whatsapp-button in upgrade.tsx).
- Notification bell: on /dist with agent token, searched testID 'notification-bell' returned 0, but the bell icon with unread badge '3' renders visibly in the agent header (screenshot). TestID name differs or bell lives in a nested component — functionally the alert UI is present and backend returns the price_change item.

Code review of src/printDoc.ts (Android PDF fix):
- expo-file-system 57: File.copy() returns Promise<void> (async); the sync counterpart is copySync() per node_modules/expo-file-system/src/internal/NativeFileSystem.types.ts:240/245.
- src/printDoc.ts:32 calls `new File(uri).copy(dest);` inside the SYNCHRONOUS helper namedCopy() and returns dest.uri immediately. Because the Promise is neither awaited nor .then-chained, Sharing.shareAsync(dest.uri, …) in shareReceipt() may fire BEFORE the file has been copied on Android — the shared file can be empty or missing, which matches the user-reported 'Android PDF share / WhatsApp PDF not working' symptom.
- Fix: either (a) switch to File#copySync(dest) (sync, keeps namedCopy sync), or (b) make namedCopy() async and await the copy inside shareReceipt. Option (a) is a one-token change and preserves the existing control flow.
- Everything else in printDoc.ts (fallback to default page size on media-size reject, Paths.cache + File constructor usage, Sharing.isAvailableAsync fallback to Print dialog) matches the installed SDK 57 surface area.
- printDoc.web.ts is unchanged and continues to be used on web — no runtime import of expo-file-system / expo-sharing on web.

SMS text replacement: DocActions.tsx exposes <Btn testID={idPrefix+'-sms-button'} title={smsTitle ?? 'إرسال رسالة نصية SMS إلى العميل'} …/> and SupplierStatements.tsx passes smsTitle='إرسال رسالة نصية SMS إلى المورد'. openSms() uses expo-sms on native and falls back to sms: URL on web (no crash observed).

integration_issues.issue: src/printDoc.ts:32 fires File#copy() (async) without awaiting it, then returns dest.uri; Sharing.shareAsync may run before the copy finishes on Android, producing an empty/missing file in the share sheet.

action_items: FIX (one line): src/printDoc.ts:32 — replace `new File(uri).copy(dest);` with `new File(uri).copySync(dest);` (expo-file-system 57 exposes File#copySync for synchronous copy). Alternative: make namedCopy() async and `await new File(uri).copy(dest)` inside an await-aware shareReceipt. This is the root cause for 'Android PDF share / WhatsApp PDF not working'.
critical_code_review_comments: src/printDoc.ts namedCopy() is synchronous but calls File#copy() which is Promise-returning — the Promise is dropped, causing the Android share-sheet to receive a race-y / empty file. Use copySync().
DocActions.tsx: legacy *-whatsapp-button testID successfully removed from doc components; *-sms-button, *-whatsapp-pdf-button, *-share-pdf-button all present with correct Arabic titles.

StockRequests.tsx: request-stock-<pid> is correctly suppressed when a pending request exists for that product (line 74). Tests should seed a product with no pending request to exercise the + button + stock-request-sheet on web.
PricingMethodPicker: all 3 options render with correct testIDs and Arabic descriptions. LATEST policy copy matches spec ('اعتماد السعر الجديد على كل البضاعة').

OrgProfile.tsx: profileBody() correctly whitelists only 8 editable keys; backend extra.ts updateOrgProfile mutator now accepts optional alt_currency/currency/has_logo/exchange_rate/pricing_method extras (schema line 253) so the alt_currency ArgumentValidationError is gone.

To interactively test stock-request-sheet on web, either reset the agent's pending stock requests or add a seeded product with no pending request; then click request-stock-<pid>, toggle stock-request-unit to PACKAGE on a product with pieces_per_package=10, enter qty, press send-stock-request-button, and confirm the created request stores pieces=10 (POST /api/stock-requests already covered by backend test). supplier-statements-button is reachable from المخزون tab — not الإدارة — adjust navigation in next UI run.
rca_of_issue: Android PDF share bug RCA: expo-file-system 57 renamed the sync file-copy API to copySync() and made copy() async (returns Promise<void>). src/printDoc.ts was ported from the pre-57 sync-copy API but kept the sync call-site shape, so the current code starts a Promise and immediately returns the destination URI. Sharing.shareAsync() then opens the share sheet with a path to a file that is still being written (or has not been created at all). On Android this manifests as WhatsApp receiving an empty attachment or 'file not found'. Reproduction: cannot be reproduced on web (printDoc.web.ts shim) — must be observed in a native build or EAS build. Mitigation: single-char change to File#copySync() restores sync semantics expected by the surrounding sync helper.
